# Latsidian

Latsidian reproduces LaTeX typography offline by embedding its fonts, with Latin Modern as the default. It adds Chinese typography through FandolSong and its fallbacks, renders code blocks in CMUNTT with FandolFang for Chinese comments, and styles academic elements such as theorem, lemma, definition and proof.

![Latsidian screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/howardzhangdqs/Latsidian/HEAD/light-simple-small.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Latsidian"
    author: "howardzhangdqs"
    repo:   "howardzhangdqs/Latsidian"
    slug:   "latsidian"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/latsidian"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/howardzhangdqs/Latsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/howardzhangdqs/Latsidian/HEAD/light-simple-small.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a LaTeX-style theme with embedded fonts (Latin Modern by default) to reproduce LaTeX typography offline. Provide Chinese typography (FandolSong with fallbacks), render code blocks with CMUNTT (FandolFang for Chinese comments), and style academic elements like theorem, lemma, definition, and proof."
}
```
